+package trafficpolicy

+type consistentHashIR struct {
+	hashPolicies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	disable      bool
+}
+
+var _ PolicySubIR = &consistentHashIR{}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Equals(other PolicySubIR) bool {
+	otherCH, ok := other.(*consistentHashIR)
+	if !ok {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c == nil && otherCH == nil {
+		return true
+	}
+	if c == nil || otherCH == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c.disable != otherCH.disable {
+		return false
+	}
+	return slices.EqualFunc(c.hashPolicies, otherCH.hashPolicies, func(a, b *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) bool {
+		return proto.Equal(a, b)
+	})
+}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Validate() error {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	for _, hp := range c.hashPolicies {
+		if err := hp.ValidateAll(); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if hdr := hp.GetHeader(); hdr != nil && hdr.GetRegexRewrite() != nil && hdr.GetRegexRewrite().GetPattern() != nil {
+			if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(hdr.GetRegexRewrite().GetPattern().GetRegex()); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid regex pattern: %w", err)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+func (c *consistentHashIR) clone() *consistentHashIR {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	if c.disable {
+		return &consistentHashIR{disable: true}
+	}
+	policies := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, len(c.hashPolicies))
+	for i, hp := range c.hashPolicies {
+		policies[i] = proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy)
+	}
+	return &consistentHashIR{
+		hashPolicies: policies,
+	}

+func parseCookieTTL(ttlStr string) (time.Duration, error) {
+	if d, err := time.ParseDuration(ttlStr); err == nil {
+		return d, nil
+	}
+	if secs, err := strconv.ParseInt(ttlStr, 10, 64); err == nil {
+		return time.Duration(secs) * time.Second, nil
+	}
+	return 0, fmt.Errorf("invalid cookie ttl %q: must be a Go duration or integer seconds", ttlStr)
+}

+	if spec.ConsistentHash == nil {
+		return nil

+	ch := spec.ConsistentHash
+

+		if len(ch.Headers) > 0 || len(ch.Cookies) > 0 || len(ch.QueryParameters) > 0 || len(ch.FilterState) > 0 || ch.SourceIp != nil {

+		}
+		return nil

+
+	// 1. headers (deduplicated case-insensitively by headerName, preserving casing of first occurrence)
+	if len(ch.Headers) > 0 {
+		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ch.Headers))
+		for _, h := range ch.Headers {
+			key := strings.ToLower(h.HeaderName)
+			if _, exists := seen[key]; exists {
+				continue
+			}
+			seen[key] = struct{}{}
+
+			hdrPolicy := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header{
+				HeaderName: h.HeaderName,
+			}
+			if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+				hdrPolicy.RegexRewrite = &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatchAndSubstitute{
+					Pattern: &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatcher{
+						Regex: h.RegexRewrite.Pattern,
+					},
+					Substitution: h.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+				}
+			}
+			hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_{
+					Header: hdrPolicy,
+				},
+				Terminal: ptr.Deref(h.Terminal, false),
+			})
+		}
+	}
+
+	// 2. cookies (deduplicated by name)
+	if len(ch.Cookies) > 0 {
+		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ch.Cookies))
+		for _, c := range ch.Cookies {
+			if _, exists := seen[c.Name]; exists {
+				continue
+			}
+			seen[c.Name] = struct{}{}
+
+			cookiePolicy := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie{
+				Name: c.Name,
+			}
+			if c.TTL != nil && *c.TTL != "" {
+				ttl, err := parseCookieTTL(*c.TTL)
+				if err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+				cookiePolicy.Ttl = durationpb.New(ttl)
+			}
+			if c.Path != nil {
+				cookiePolicy.Path = *c.Path
+			}
+			if len(c.Attributes) > 0 {
+				attrs := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute, 0, len(c.Attributes))
+				for _, attr := range c.Attributes {
+					attrs = append(attrs, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute{
+						Name:  attr.Name,
+						Value: attr.Value,
+					})
+				}
+				cookiePolicy.Attributes = attrs
+			}
+			hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_{
+					Cookie: cookiePolicy,
+				},
+				Terminal: ptr.Deref(c.Terminal, false),
+			})
+		}
+	}
+
+	// 3. queryParameters (deduplicated by name)
+	if len(ch.QueryParameters) > 0 {
+		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ch.QueryParameters))
+		for _, qp := range ch.QueryParameters {
+			if _, exists := seen[qp.Name]; exists {
+				continue
+			}
+			seen[qp.Name] = struct{}{}
+
+			hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_{
+					QueryParameter: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter{
+						Name: qp.Name,
+					},
+				},
+				Terminal: ptr.Deref(qp.Terminal, false),
+			})
+		}
+	}
+
+	// 4. filterState (deduplicated by key)
+	if len(ch.FilterState) > 0 {
+		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ch.FilterState))
+		for _, fs := range ch.FilterState {
+			if _, exists := seen[fs.Key]; exists {
+				continue
+			}
+			seen[fs.Key] = struct{}{}
+
+			hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_{
+					FilterState: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState{
+						Key: fs.Key,
+					},
+				},
+				Terminal: ptr.Deref(fs.Terminal, false),
+			})
+		}
+	}
+
+	// 5. sourceIp
+	if ch.SourceIp != nil {
+		hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+				ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+					SourceIp: true,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(ch.SourceIp.Terminal, false),
+		})
+	}
+
+	// If no sub-fields are specified, default to a single sourceIp hash policy with terminal=false.
+	if len(hashPolicies) == 0 {
+		hashPolicies = []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{defaultSourceIPHashPolicy()}
+	}
+
+	out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+		hashPolicies: hashPolicies,
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func applyConsistentHash(ch *consistentHashIR, out *envoyroutev3.Route) {
+	if ch == nil || out == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	action := out.GetRoute()
+	if action == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	if ch.disable {
+		action.HashPolicy = nil
+		return
+	}
+	if len(ch.hashPolicies) == 0 {
+		action.HashPolicy = []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{defaultSourceIPHashPolicy()}
+		return
+	}
+	action.HashPolicy = ch.hashPolicies
+}
+
+func hashPolicyTypeOrder(hp *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) int {
+	switch hp.GetPolicySpecifier().(type) {
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_:
+		return 0
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_:
+		return 1
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_:
+		return 2
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_:
+		return 3
+	case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_:
+		return 4
+	default:
+		return 5
+	}
+}
+
+func mergeHashPolicies(high, low []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	seenHeaders := make(map[string]struct{})
+	seenCookies := make(map[string]struct{})
+	seenQueryParams := make(map[string]struct{})
+	seenFilterState := make(map[string]struct{})
+
+	var merged []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+
+	for _, hp := range high {
+		switch spec := hp.GetPolicySpecifier().(type) {
+		case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_:
+			key := strings.ToLower(spec.Header.GetHeaderName())
+			if _, exists := seenHeaders[key]; exists {
+				continue
+			}
+			seenHeaders[key] = struct{}{}
+			merged = append(merged, proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy))
+		case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_:
+			key := spec.Cookie.GetName()
+			if _, exists := seenCookies[key]; exists {
+				continue
+			}
+			seenCookies[key] = struct{}{}
+			merged = append(merged, proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy))
+		case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_:
+			key := spec.QueryParameter.GetName()
+			if _, exists := seenQueryParams[key]; exists {
+				continue
+			}
+			seenQueryParams[key] = struct{}{}
+			merged = append(merged, proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy))
+		case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_:
+			key := spec.FilterState.GetKey()
+			if _, exists := seenFilterState[key]; exists {
+				continue
+			}
+			seenFilterState[key] = struct{}{}
+			merged = append(merged, proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy))
+		case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_:
+			merged = append(merged, proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy))
+		}
+	}
+
+	for _, hp := range low {
+		switch spec := hp.GetPolicySpecifier().(type) {
+		case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_:
+			key := strings.ToLower(spec.Header.GetHeaderName())
+			if _, exists := seenHeaders[key]; exists {
+				continue
+			}
+			seenHeaders[key] = struct{}{}
+			merged = append(merged, proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy))
+		case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_:
+			key := spec.Cookie.GetName()
+			if _, exists := seenCookies[key]; exists {
+				continue
+			}
+			seenCookies[key] = struct{}{}
+			merged = append(merged, proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy))
+		case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_:
+			key := spec.QueryParameter.GetName()
+			if _, exists := seenQueryParams[key]; exists {
+				continue
+			}
+			seenQueryParams[key] = struct{}{}
+			merged = append(merged, proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy))
+		case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_:
+			key := spec.FilterState.GetKey()
+			if _, exists := seenFilterState[key]; exists {
+				continue
+			}
+			seenFilterState[key] = struct{}{}
+			merged = append(merged, proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy))
+		case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_:
+			// The sourceIp scalar retains the higher-priority policy's value even when unset.
+		}
+	}
+
+	slices.SortStableFunc(merged, func(a, b *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) int {
+		return cmp.Compare(hashPolicyTypeOrder(a), hashPolicyTypeOrder(b))
+	})
+
+	return merged
+}
+
+func mergeConsistentHash(
+	p1, p2 *TrafficPolicy,
+	p2Ref *ir.AttachedPolicyRef,
+	p2MergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	opts policy.MergeOptions,
+	mergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	_ TrafficPolicyMergeOpts,
+) {
+	if p2.spec.consistentHash == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	if p1.spec.consistentHash == nil {
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = p2.spec.consistentHash.clone()
+		mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		return
+	}
+
+	switch opts.Strategy {
+	case policy.AugmentedShallowMerge, policy.AugmentedDeepMerge:
+		// p1 is higher priority than p2
+		if p1.spec.consistentHash.disable {
+			return
+		}
+		if p2.spec.consistentHash.disable {
+			return
+		}
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+			hashPolicies: mergeHashPolicies(p1.spec.consistentHash.hashPolicies, p2.spec.consistentHash.hashPolicies),
+		}
+		mergeOrigins.Append("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+
+	case policy.OverridableShallowMerge, policy.OverridableDeepMerge:
+		// p2 is higher priority than p1
+		if p2.spec.consistentHash.disable {
+			p1.spec.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{disable: true}
+			mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+			return
+		}
+		if p1.spec.consistentHash.disable {
+			p1.spec.consistentHash = p2.spec.consistentHash.clone()
+			mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+			return
+		}
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+			hashPolicies: mergeHashPolicies(p2.spec.consistentHash.hashPolicies, p1.spec.consistentHash.hashPolicies),
+		}
+		mergeOrigins.Append("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+
+	default:
+		logger.Warn("unsupported merge strategy for consistentHash policy", "strategy", opts.Strategy, "policy", p2Ref)
+	}
+}

+			},
+		}, 0, "")
+
+		// Low-priority policy has duplicate header x-first (different case), new header x-second,
+		// duplicate cookie c1, new cookie c2, queryParameter qp1, filterState fs2, and sourceIp
+		low := buildPolicyAtt("low-policy", &kgateway.ConsistentHash{
+			Headers: []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader{

+			},
+			Cookies: []kgateway.ConsistentHashCookie{
+				{Name: "c1", Path: new("/low")},
+				{Name: "c2", Path: new("/low2")},
+			},
+			QueryParameters: []kgateway.ConsistentHashQueryParameter{
+				{Name: "qp1", Terminal: new(false)},
+			},
+			FilterState: []kgateway.ConsistentHashFilterState{

+				{Key: "fs2", Terminal: new(false)},

+		// 1: Header "x-second" (from low, terminal=false)
+		// 2: Cookie "c1" (from high, path=/high)
+		// 3: Cookie "c2" (from low, path=/low2)
+		// 4: QueryParameter "qp1" (from low)
+		// 5: FilterState "fs1" (from high, terminal=true)

+		// Merge metadata records consistentHash with both policies

+			},

+		low := buildPolicyAtt("low-policy", &kgateway.ConsistentHash{

+			Headers: []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader{

+	})
